pairs: Una autem sabbati valde diluculo venerunt ad monumentum, portantes quæ paraverant aromata:
Then, on the first Sabbath, at very first light, they went to the tomb, carrying the aromatic spices that they had prepared.
et invenerunt lapidem revolutum a monumento.
And they found the stone rolled back from the tomb.
Et ingressæ non invenerunt corpus Domini Jesu.
And upon entering, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
dum mente consternatæ essent de isto,
while their minds were still confused about this,
ecce duo viri steterunt secus illas in veste fulgenti.
behold, two men stood beside them, in shining apparel.
since they were afraid and were turning their faces toward the ground,
“Why do you seek the living with the dead?
Recall how he spoke to you,
when he was still in Galilee,
Quia oportet Filium hominis tradi in manus hominum peccatorum,
‘For the Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men,
and on the third day rise again.’”
And they called to mind his words.
Et regressæ a monumento nuntiaverunt hæc omnia illis undecim,
And returning from the tomb, they reported all these things to the eleven,
et ceteræ quæ cum eis erant,
and the other women who were with them,
who told these things to the Apostles.
Et visa sunt ante illos sicut deliramentum verba ista,
But these words seemed to them a delusion.
And so they did not believe them.
Petrus autem surgens cucurrit ad monumentum:
But Peter, rising up, ran to the tomb.
et procumbens vidit linteamina sola posita,
And stooping down, he saw the linen cloths positioned alone,
et abiit secum mirans quod factum fuerat.
and he went away wondering to himself about what had happened.
Et ecce duo ex illis ibant ipsa die in castellum,
And behold, two of them went out, on the same day,
quod erat in spatio stadiorum sexaginta ab Jerusalem, nomine Emmaus.
to a town named Emmaus, which was the distance of sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
Et ipsi loquebantur ad invicem de his omnibus quæ acciderant.
And they spoke to one another about all of these things that had occurred.
while they were speculating and questioning within themselves,
et ipse Jesus appropinquans ibat cum illis:
Jesus himself, drawing near, traveled with them.
oculi autem illorum tenebantur ne eum agnoscerent.
But their eyes were restrained, so that they would not recognize him.
which you are discussing with one another,
as you walk and are sad?”
And one of them, whose name was Cleopas,
dixit ei: Tu solus peregrinus es in Jerusalem, et non cognovisti quæ facta sunt in illa his diebus?
“Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”
And he said to them, “What things?”
potens in opere et sermone coram Deo et omni populo:
powerful in works and in words, before God and all the people.
et quomodo eum tradiderunt summi sacerdotes et principes nostri in damnationem mortis,
And how our high priests and leaders handed him over to be condemned to death.
nos autem sperabamus quia ipse esset redempturus Israël:
But we were hoping that he would be the Redeemer of Israel.
And now, on top of all this,
tertia dies est hodie quod hæc facta sunt.
today is the third day since these things have happened.
Sed et mulieres quædam ex nostris terruerunt nos,
Then, too, certain women from among us terrified us.
quæ ante lucem fuerunt ad monumentum,
For before daytime, they were at the tomb,
and, having not found his body,
dicentes se etiam visionem angelorum vidisse,
saying that they had even seen a vision of Angels,
who said that he is alive.
Et abierunt quidam ex nostris ad monumentum:
And some of us went out to the tomb.
et ita invenerunt sicut mulieres dixerunt,
And they found it just as the women had said.
But truly, they did not find him.”
“How foolish and reluctant in heart you are,
et tardi corde ad credendum in omnibus quæ locuti sunt prophetæ!
to believe everything that has been spoken by the Prophets!
Was not the Christ required to suffer these things,
et ita intrare in gloriam suam?
and so enter into his glory?”
Et incipiens a Moyse, et omnibus prophetis,
And beginning from Moses and all the Prophets,
interpretabatur illis in omnibus scripturis quæ de ipso erant.
he interpreted for them, in all the Scriptures, the things that were about him.
And they drew near to the town where they were going.
et ipse se finxit longius ire.
And he conducted himself so as to go on further.
But they were insistent with him,
And so he entered with them.
while he was at table with them,
and he extended it to them.
et ipse evanuit ex oculis eorum.
And he vanished from their eyes.
And they said to one another,
Nonne cor nostrum ardens erat in nobis dum loqueretur in via,
“Was not our heart burning within us, while he was speaking on the way,
and when he opened the Scriptures to us?”
Et surgentes eadem hora regressi sunt in Jerusalem:
And rising up at that same hour, they returned to Jerusalem.
And they found the eleven gathered together,
et eos qui cum illis erant,
and those who were with them,
and he has appeared to Simon.”
Et ipsi narrabant quæ gesta erant in via,
And they explained the things that were done on the way,
et quomodo cognoverunt eum in fractione panis.
and how they had recognized him at the breaking of the bread.
Then, while they were talking about these things,
“Peace be with you. It is I.
they were very disturbed and terrified,
supposing that they saw a spirit.
et cogitationes ascendunt in corda vestra?
and why do these thoughts rise up in your hearts?
quia spiritus carnem et ossa non habet,
For a spirit does not have flesh and bones,
as you see that I have.”
And when he had said this,
he showed them his hands and feet.
while they were still in disbelief and in wonder out of joy,
“Do you have anything here to eat?”
At illi obtulerunt ei partem piscis assi et favum mellis.
And they offered him a piece of roasted fish and a honeycomb.
And when he had eaten these in their sight,
taking up what was left, he gave it to them.
Hæc sunt verba quæ locutus sum ad vos cum adhuc essem vobiscum,
“These are the words that I spoke to you when I was still with you,
quoniam necesse est impleri omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Moysi,
because all things must be fulfilled which are written in the law of Moses,
and in the Psalms about me.”
Tunc aperuit illis sensum ut intelligerent Scripturas,
Then he opened their mind, so that they might understand the Scriptures.
et resurgere a mortuis tertia die:
for the Christ to suffer and to rise up from the dead on the third day,
et prædicari in nomine ejus pœnitentiam, et remissionem peccatorum in omnes gentes, incipientibus ab Jerosolyma.
and, in his name, for repentance and the remission of sins to be preached, among all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
And you are witnesses of these things.
Et ego mitto promissum Patris mei in vos;
And I am sending the Promise of my Father upon you.
But you must stay in the city,
until such time as you are clothed with power from on high.”
Eduxit autem eos foras in Bethaniam,
Then he led them out as far as Bethania.
et elevatis manibus suis benedixit eis.
And lifting up his hands, he blessed them.
and he was carried up into heaven.
Et ipsi adorantes regressi sunt in Jerusalem cum gaudio magno:
And worshiping, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
And they were always in the temple,
